Customizing Word Ribbon toolbars in Word and Excel 2013 supports customizable Quick Access Toolbars—but Word's Quick Access Toolbar supports running at startup, an option I missed greatly when I first tested the new Word. Customization of the editing toolbar is a different matter. Apart from location on the screen (below or above the ribbon), you can also group and hide other small icons at the top-right and bottom-right of the toolbars. To include icons in the Quick Access Toolbar, press the Customize Quick Access Toolbar button, followed by selecting the buttons to add or dragging them to your preferred location.
